note: The caps' values live in client/src/flags.ts (lowmemcap, lowmembudget, lowmemr, lowmemhyst), which no region can name; the model is parametric in Cap. main.ts fills the queue (streamList, passed to low-mem.ts as pending) at top level during boot, before any match, which no region or allow entry can name; the model starts with every POI queued, and the scan does not see streamList writes, so read main.ts's boot loop against Init when it changes.

writes.what: which streamed POIs are queued, building or built: building and pending are module state of low-mem.ts and main.ts's stream()

allow.why: __kr.rebuildModule, a developer hook typed into the browser console (no game code or tool calls it): evicts one module and builds it again, outside the streaming queue the model describes.
